# `desktop` operations

2 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all areas](README.md).

### desktop.status

**Desktop status**

Read recent jobs and live preview sessions for the desktop panel.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, open world.

Takes no arguments.

```sh
tomaccoctl call desktop.status
```

### desktop.open

**Open Tomacco**

Show an existing desktop session or start one, opening the requested workspace tab.

Annotations: writes, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tab` | string |  | `"runtime"` | one of `runtime`, `preview`, `project`, `devices`, `ios-research`, `jobs`, `tools`, `debug`, `testing`, `profiling`, `files`, `release` |
| `session` | string |  | `"main"` | matching `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}`; Running preview session name; defaults to main |
| `path` | string |  |  | Project root to open |
| `file` | string |  |  | Project-relative source file to reveal in the files tab |
| `line` | integer |  | `1` | 1 to 10000000 |
| `device_only` | boolean |  | `false` | Start the desktop without showing its main window, for a detached device window. A desktop that is already running is left as it is. |

```sh
tomaccoctl call desktop.open
```
